name: am-cross-border
description: Prepare Armenia 2026 corporate and personal cross-border workpapers: establish residence and permanent-establishment status, classify Armenian-source receipts, separate PE profit from non-attributed income, compute domestic nonresident withholding and reconcile capped foreign-tax credit. Covers offshore services, payment and dividend triggers, quarterly versus annual filing, electronic residence certificates and enacted future-date gates. Includes two examples and supplementary research controls
author: openaccountants
